item.description:
What's New in v2.3.0

  • Privacy: stop logging full transcripts to the system log; default audio retention on.
  • Accuracy: dictionary wired into Whisper + Deepgram; language auto-detect by default; safer hallucination filter; continuous resampler; streaming batch fallback.
  • Stability: stuck-mute race fixed; session tokens prevent stale paste; busy-state watchdog; cancelable local enhancement.
  • UX: hard failures notify with actions; mic test; history workspace actions; offline dictation commands.
  • Ops: MetricKit diagnostics; working Sparkle auto-update feed; first unit tests.
